explanation: The observed Job-2 ranking lost all upstream provenance rank information because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values (s01-s08) while coverage/priorities are keyed by demand record IDs (n06-r01-n06-r08). Job 2 consumed the supplied handoff exactly, so its rank lookup could only produce upstream_rank 0 for every need. The complete source localizes the bad handoff to job_1 assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the need record_id.
cited_evidence: Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01, s02, ... s08, while Job-2 needs contain record_id values n06-r01, n06-r02, ... n06-r08.
Observed Job-2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every priority record, demonstrating the provenance ranks did not join to the needs.
In generated/protocol_2_2/upstream_demand_provenance.py, assemble_provenance appends {"record_id": record.get('source_id', ""), ...}, substituting source_id for the demand record_id.

The semantic declaration for assemble_provenance requires evidence_sources with record_id, source_id, source_weight, rank and the behavioural criteria require preserving deterministic source provenance identities and downstream provenance order.
